en.basel-kadem: 1.	We were told by my father, may Allah grant him mercy, that he said: We were told by Muhammed bin Yahya al-‘Attar, from Muhammed bin Ahmad bin Ibrahim bin Ishaq, from Muhammed bin Sulayman al-Daylami, from his father, that he said: Abu Abdillah, peace be upon him, said:
Do not abandon the standing during the night, for indeed, the defrauded is the one who is defrauded from the standing during the night (in prayer).
